# Embedded emissions cannot be calculated yet

The ruleset requires three inputs: the CN code, the country of production and the quantity. The CN code is missing.

| Required input | Scenario value | Status |
|---|---|---|
| CN code in table | "(to be confirmed)": "steel long product (exact heading TBD by mill)" | ❌ Missing |
| Country of production | Türkiye | ✅ Listed |
| Quantity (t) | 1,000 t | ✅ Provided |

## Why the CN code can't be inferred

The default SEE depends on both the CN code and the country. "Steel long product" doesn't identify a single code. For Türkiye, the table has four possible factors:

| CN code | Good | Default SEE, Türkiye (tCO2e/t) |
|---|---|---|
| 7201 | Pig iron and spiegeleisen | 1.85 |
| 7206 10 00 | Ingots, iron/non-alloy steel | 1.96 |
| 7207 11 90 | Semi-finished products, iron/non-alloy steel | 3.087 |
| 7214 20 00 | Bars and rods with indentations (rebar) | 2.31 |

Picking one of these would be an estimate, which the ruleset doesn't allow.

## Next step

Ask the mill to confirm the exact CN code. Once confirmed, the calculation is:

**Embedded emissions = SEE (CN code, Türkiye) × 1,000 t**, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.

If the confirmed code isn't in the table above, the factor table doesn't cover it, and the emissions still can't be computed under this ruleset.
